HEARME.OS1setup
Welcome 1.1
hearmeHold a key, talk, and your words are typed wherever you're writing. Everything runs locally — your voice never leaves this Mac.
Permissions
.. Microphoneto hear you — asked on your first dictation
.. Accessibilityfor the shortcut and to type text — restart hearme once after granting
.. Globe (fn) keyset "Press 🌐 key to" → Do Nothing, so fn only dictates
Try it

Click into any text field, hold the Dictate key, speak, release.

Finish
Running hearme from a terminal? Grant these to the terminal app instead.
